testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-signed-in.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23096 sales rep sees only the allowed menu items

scenario.summary: A sales rep signs in to the admin panel, lands on the Dashboard and sees only Accounts & Users (Accounts, Users) and OMS (Orders, Quotes, Returns, Pending Orders, Pending Payments, Vouchers); Dashboard is the landing page, not a menu item; every other menu is hidden.
steps: Sign in to the admin panel as the sales rep (@rep.userName, @rep.password).
Check the page shown after sign-in.
assertions: After sign-in the Dashboard is displayed
Menu items are exactly Accounts & Users with Accounts, Users, and OMS with Orders, Quotes, Returns, Pending Orders, Pending Payments, Vouchers
Dashboard is not a menu item; no Customers menu; no other menu is shown
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 2 and answers in section 6.

Phase 2 (story Z10-38546): FSD 'Salesrep Phase 2 - Account Association' section 10 (navigation: Customers renamed to Accounts & Users; Accounts, Users; OMS menus) and section 11 (Dashboard displayed immediately after login); work/stories/Z10-38546/analysis.md section 2 and user answer 1 (expect the Phase 2 menu, Dashboard as landing page, not a menu item).
Phase 1 FSD 'Sales Rep Login Experience in Admin panel' listed Dashboard and Customers; replaced by Phase 2 (atstage run 6 shows the Phase 2 menu).
The sales rep signs in on the suite's admin URL with the password the SALES_REP_OF_STORE collection sets through the API (analysis answer 2).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
